name: Space Metal Mania
summary:
The galaxy needs saving and only metal can do it.

The Metal-Verse is a galaxy united by one truth: metal is life. Now The Silence, an ancient consuming force, is spreading across worlds and draining everything it touches. Lucky for us, heavy metal can destroy them. Grab the controls, crank it to eleven, and blast them back into the void.

Space Metal Mania is a fast-paced, heavy metal-fueled, arcade space shooter where you blast through swarms of enemies, face down massive bosses, and fight to reclaim a galaxy decimated by the Silence. Play solo or team up with up to 3 friends in explosive co-op multiplayer that is all set to a face-melting soundtrack featuring legendary tracks from Megadeth, Iron Maiden, Mastodon, Avenged Sevenfold, and Pantera.

Your commander? None other than Dave Mustaine, the iconic Megadeth frontman who is guiding you through every mission with his unmistakable voice.
